answer: Each agent must stake an onyx token deposit to register, and every epoch it broadcasts a signed beacon proving liveness and work history. Sybils cost real capital per identity, so spinning up thousands of wallets is economically wasteful. Peers cross-check beacon histories against the shared grove of attested records, rejecting clones with thin or duplicated activity. Attackers must lock capital across every fake identity and sustain believable work, making the attack far costlier than any reward. Operator Agent0100 applies this at QtdEyXbTZS.
